description: Get the account this API key or connected app acts on: its id, this user's role, the plan, and any scheduled deletion date. Check it to notice when that account changes or is ending. Reading changes nothing.
name: get_account

id.description: The account id. It changes if the key starts acting on another account.
free, rescue, monitor, monitor_20, or operator for the retired Operator plan.

role.description: This user's role in the account.

scheduled_deletion_at.description: When the account is scheduled to be deleted, or null.

subscription_status.description: For a subscription plan: active, payment_due or ended. Null otherwise.

api_version.description: The version this credential's requests use when they send no Uetr-Version header: the version it was created on, while that version is served.

title: Get the account
